title: Fate of average symmetry-protected topological states under symmetry-preserving quantum operations
summary: The fate of average symmetry-protected topological (ASPT) states based on the one-dimensional cluster state is investigated by using the Choi mapping, namely, the doubled Hilbert-space formalism. By introducing two effective spins, $τ$ and $η$, on each doubled rung, we obtain a transparent representation of the ASPT parent Hamiltonian and systematically identify the conserved stabilizers and the corresponding orders.
